$$PMT = P \times \frac{r(1+r)^n}{(1+r)^n - 1}$$

- n = number of months = 60

$(1+r)^n - 1 = 1.348850153 - 1 = 0.348850153$

Now I can calculate the payment:
$$PMT = 20000 \times \frac{0.006744250765}{0.348850153}$$

$$PMT = 20000 \times 0.0193328733$$

$PV = 386.66 \times \frac{1-0.741372174}{0.005}$

$PV = 386.66 \times \frac{0.258627826}{0.005}$

$PV = 386.66 \times 51.7255652$
